purpose: Convert high-value Aug-4 Drive handoff findings into current executable regression requirements without treating operational prose as current truth.

oracles.name: background_loop_failures_must_be_visible
oracles.historical_evidence: P4 reports 1275 swallow-capable exception sites, 1100 broad catches and 241 in consciousness_daemon.py after Attention Controller and ThoughtSeed had died silently.
oracles.required_pass: Injected exceptions in every long-running critical loop produce a typed fault event, health-state transition and externally testable failure signal; no loop may silently disappear behind broad catch-and-continue behavior.

oracles.name: checkpoint_state_shape_version_mismatch
oracles.historical_evidence: P4 records NAc STATE_DIM changing 102->100 while a persisted SFT anchor remained shape (64,102), requiring stale-shape reset logic.
oracles.required_pass: Every persisted model/state/checkpoint artifact carries schema/version/shape identity; incompatible load fails closed or runs an explicit verified migration/reset path and emits a receipt.

oracles.name: training_runtime_prompt_freshness
oracles.historical_evidence: P3/P4 report repeated train/inference drift and propose a guard that fails when a prompt extract is older than living runtime source.
oracles.required_pass: Training/evaluation prompt projections are provenance-bound to exact runtime semantic source/version; stale snapshots fail the data/eval gate rather than silently training against obsolete semantics.

oracles.name: live_vs_repository_state_source_truth
oracles.historical_evidence: P3 reports same-named repository database paths had become stale while live state existed under a runtime data directory.
oracles.required_pass: Harness identifies authoritative live-state location through configuration/provenance rather than filename/path coincidence and rejects stale duplicate stores as current truth.

oracles.name: lora_target_modules_must_exist_in_actual_model
oracles.historical_evidence: P3 reports Qwen3.5 hybrid full/linear-attention layers where standard q/k/v/o projection names exist only in full-attention layers.
oracles.required_pass: Before any allowed training run, a model-structure probe resolves intended target modules against the exact immutable model config and rejects missing/partial target coverage unless explicitly designed and measured.
